name: csk_hanoi_pipeline
description: COSMO-SkyMed HIMAGE ascending, central Hanoi, 18 epochs 2011-07-01..2014-12-12, the production chain of hanoi_csk: raw HDF5 -> native stripmap stack -> phase linking (adaptive, Anderson-Darling SHP, Gaussian post-filter) -> ps engine -> product. The project configuration is frozen in csk_hanoi_pipeline.toml; the AOI is cut to 2.6 x 2.6 km to keep the run short. Reference regenerated 2026-11-07 after the unwrapping changes (unwrap_patch_phase = n: the grid unwraps ph_rc; grid filter sigma in metres; temporal edge rates; PS rate model auto, off at 17 interferograms); the 2026-10-25 reference (patch phase) is kept as expected_2026-10-25_patch_phase.
